Helper to plot missingness heatmap

dot-plotSigHeatmap.Rd

Helper to plot missingness heatmap

Usage

.plotSigHeatmap(mat, scaled, anno.df, anno.pal, ...)

Arguments

mat

Matrix of imputed data subset to differentially abundant metabolites

scaled

Whether the input matrix was scaled

anno.df

Annotation data.frame with the sample groups

anno.pal

List named with anno.df column names containing named color vectors where the color vector names correspond to the elements of anno. See .getAnnoColors()

...

Arguments passed on to ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap

color

The same as in pheatmap. Here you don't necessarily need to generate a long color vector. The discrete colors sent to colorRampPalette are also OK here. E.g. colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdYlBu")))(100) can be simply replaced as rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdYlBu")).

The same as in pheatmap.

The same as in pheatmap.

The same as in pheatmap.
